Palus will save you dozens of hours on operations work, help you avoid making financial mistakes, and our cash management service

description: Mango Medical builds agentic surgical planning AI for orthopedic surgery. We deliver surgeon-ready plans in minutes instead of days. 8-figure LOI from a top orthopedic company. Pursuing FDA 510(k) clearance. We're building a future where every surgery follows a personalized plan.

description: Human-assisted development should be for novel ideation, not routine maintenance, bug fixes or incremental updates. description: Balance is an AI accounting firm that helps SMBs close their monthly books. Our agents do the work of an in-house finance hire, reconciling books in real time and flagging issues before they become problems.

name: Origami Robotics
one_liner: Manipulate Anything Robot
description: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.

name: HealthSpark
one_liner: Empowering Physical Therapists to Go Independent
description: HealthSpark empowers physical therapists (PTs) to start, run, and grow their own independent practices. Our AI-native “business-in-a-box” takes care of the administrative work—credentialing, insurance billing, patient onboarding, documentation, and scheduling—so PTs can focus on patient care, not paperwork.

name: Unusual
one_liner: Market to AI agents
description:
AI agents are the newest audience brands need to speak to, but go-to-market teams don't have the tools to understand how they form opinions or make decisions.

Unusual helps brands in the Fortune 100 and scale-ups like Change.org and Astronomer drive more sales and win more market share by shifting how AI models perceive their offerings.

We work closely with every brand to (1) identify the root cause of AI misperception, (2) align on marketing, sales, and product strategies that appeal to agents, and (3) build infrastructure and content that makes their strongest proof more legible to age

Onboarding takes 5 minutes.

name: Mixy

Live out your DJ dreams with Mixy, the mind-blowing music app that lets you mash-up any song in seconds.

Nursing facilities continue to operate with zero visibility which leads to $15 billion in equipment waste annually. We use physical trackers and AI agents to eliminate this.

one_liner: A proactive desktop copilot. Clippy, but actually good.
description: Logical is a desktop AI that acts as a proactive and largely promptless copilot, designed to reduce the friction of using AI for everyday tasks. It transfers context across apps, and allows taking action on many apps with just a few clicks. Logical can assist with drafting emails, writing docs, noting meetings and can even automatically detect action items. Need to prompt? Logical can understand intent in much fewer words than a regular chatbot. Plus, user data is never sent to Logical servers. Logical is the AI resurrection of Clippy, but actually good.

name: Bluma
one_liner: Canva for short-form video ads
description:
Bluma is the first AI short form content engine.

In a post-AI world, attention is the most valuable commodity. Social media is only growing faster and faster, and we're still early.

We automate your entire consumer marketing strategy by cloning your competitor's viral videos.

Everything that a growth team would plan, script, produce, and edit, Bluma can clone end-to-end and at scale.

name: Blaxel
one_liner: The perpetual sandbox platform
description:
Blaxel is the perpetual sandbox platform for AI agents that need to run code fast.

Unlike traditional sandboxes that expire or suffer from cold starts, our sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 1s of inactivity and resume in under 25ms with full memory state preserved — allowing you to keep millions of secure sandboxes on standby indefinitely.

We also co-locate your agent logic alongside these sandboxes to eliminate network overhead, delivering near-instant latency for end users.

name: The Robot Learning Company
one_liner: The infrastructure that robot intelligence is built and deployed on.

name: Tegore
one_liner: Your new AI-powered math tutor.
description:
Tegore follows K-12 school curriculum to design courses like Algebra I & Algebra II. In addition to working with high schools in the Bay Area to design the best in-classroom experiences, Tegore is developing the corresponding consumer product, a Duolingo for Math.

Each lesson in Tegore follows a lesson plan (e.g. Polynomial Long Division), and the content is delivered with voice / interactive visuals, and checks students' understanding by using dialectic teaching.

name: Third Chair
one_liner: AI-Native IP Enforcement Agent
description:
Third Chair works with IP rightsholders to enforce and monetize their rights, supported by an on-demand network of top lawyers to step in when you need them.

We’ve started with revenue-generating workflows, giving media companies visibility into who’s using their content and helping them turn unauthorized ads into a predictable income stream.

The biggest media and entertainment companies like Universal Music Group in the world rely on Third Chair to enforce their intellectual property, unlock licensing revenue, and accelerate deal flow.

name: Lumari

description:
Lumari is the world's first AI-powered procurement automation platform purpose-built for direct materials and supply chain execution. 

Backed by Y Combinator, Lumari is a well-funded startup that deploys 100s of always-on AI agents that run sourcing workflows, manage RFQs, expedite purchase orders, and coordinate supplier communication end-to-end -- compressing cycle times and giving teams full visibility into active orders, RFQs, and supplier performance.

Founded by engineers from Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Stripe who have built and scaled supply chain systems serving millions of users.
